plugins.name: 2D Video Editing Studio

plugins.name: DeepX Google Flow Studio
plugins.description: DeepX Google Flow Studio (v1.2.0): the complete DeepX Flow extension as an AntiGem MCP plugin — no side panel. Checks Google login, asks Agent Mode vs Standard mode before every generation; Agent Mode auto-splits big batches into ≤24-item parts pasted back-to-back with 100% autopilot approvals; Standard mode runs on AntiGem's native Flow engine and auto-switches to Agent Mode when Google shows an unusual-activity / extension block. Includes storyboard analyzer, characters, references, scene chaining, upscale, downloads and all deepx_* / flow_* tools. v1.2.0: Google Flow Nov 2026 update — Agent spark switch in the prompt box, quick answers with auto side panel, and semantic project asset search (exact + similar results).
